# Vendored browser dependencies

These files are served locally so visiting the blog does not contact a CDN.

- `cookieconsent/`: [Vanilla CookieConsent 3.1.0](https://github.com/orestbida/cookieconsent), MIT license
- `mermaid/`: [Mermaid 10.9.8](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid), MIT license

The corresponding license text is stored in each dependency directory.
